a11y.apg: No APG pattern for a code editor. The keyboard is CodeMirror's basicSetup, and the important part is what is NOT bound: `indentWithTab` is deliberately absent, so Tab MOVES FOCUS OUT instead of indenting. An editor that swallows Tab is a keyboard trap (WCAG 2.1.2). The editing surface carries the accessible name through contentAttributes, which is why `ariaLabel` reaches the element that actually takes focus.
a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 29/08/2026 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). This ficha comes from the lineage that did not have check 30, so it declared keys with no measurement behind them — the merge of the two lineages on 29/08/2026 is what surfaced it. Confirmed: Enter, which opens a line and auto-indents it. Enter was delivered by the editor and NOT declared before this measurement. LIMITS, and they are the method's: Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z cannot be reached because the probe presses keys WITHOUT modifiers by design — the same limit the DataGrid's F2 and Control+Home have. Tab and Shift+Tab are out of the count on both sides, since Tab moves focus anywhere on a page. Home and End were not observed: in CodeMirror they move the caret, and a caret is not in the DOM snapshot this probe takes — absence of an observable change does not prove absence of effect. The document is a contenteditable and the engine is a third party (CodeMirror), so what this note establishes is the boundary of what our instrument can say about it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting document. Uncontrolled: it is read on mount and never again, so typing does not fight a re-render.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires on every document change. Held through a ref, which is why replacing the handler does not tear down the editor and lose the undo history.

props.name: extensions
props.description: Where your language goes. No language is bundled on purpose — pass @codemirror/lang-* and the weight, and the choice, stay yours.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Reconfigured through a CodeMirror Compartment, so toggling it keeps the document, the selection and the history intact.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the editing area. It goes on the contenteditable itself, which is the element that takes focus.

props.name: className
props.description: On the host element that CodeMirror mounts into.
